Gia: Quick ask — customer hit unexpected spillover because billing metering lagged by ~20m. Can we add a 'spill_credit' toggle to avoid charging customers until reconciliation?

Arun: Technically doable but we need clear semantics. Toggle would mark overflow tokens as credit_pending and emit event. Billing can reconcile later.

Tess: Ops note: if we delay charging, we must not hide leaks. Need alert when credit_pending > X tokens for >30m.

Vik: Finance ok with temporary credits for pilot, but require exportable ledger events: credit_pending, credit_applied, reconciliation_delta. Also need console flag per-tenant for opt-in.

Arun: Minimal impl: add header X-Spill-Credit: true on admission; emit metric spill_credit_tokens{tenant,pool}. PromQL to alert:
```
sum(spill_credit_tokens{tenant=~".+"}) by (tenant) > 1000000
```

Tess: Runbook: if credit_pending spikes, SRE will pause spill_credit and notify billing/product. Quick disable:
```
POST /api/tenants/<id>/flags {"spill_credit":false}
```

Gia: Gate for pilot: (1) ledger events in BQ, (2) alert for credit_threshold, (3) UI toggle, (4) 48h pilot with single customer. Owners: Arun (impl), Tess (alerts/runbook), Vik (billing events), Gia (pilot).

deploy-bot: deploy: feature-flag "spill-credit" toggled for tenant=pilot-acme by Arun at 1791234575

Vik: I'll prepare billing FAQ and reconciliation query.

Gia: Thanks. We'll review pilot metrics in 48h. Ping here if you see regressions.
